title: StackOverflowError trace event state
description: Shape of the state field for stackoverflow-error trace events: one thread call stack of fixed maximum size, with frames pushed and popped, and a flag for the moment it overflows.

limit.description: Maximum number of frames the stack can hold before it overflows.

overflowed.description: True once a push has exceeded the limit (StackOverflowError).

frames.description: The current call stack, bottom frame (main) first.
